title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame
objectives: TODO: 2 sentences in your own words (read Description on the PSI page)
approach: The ACME Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame (CLD) tests burned methane and ethylene jet flames, diluted with nitrogen, in the Combustion Integrated Rack on the ISS, over 32 test days listed in the experiment table (2017 to 2021) with 344 flames ignited. Fuel concentration was varied between and during tests. Each test point has a 125 Hz record of flow controllers, ion current, light sensors, thermocouples and radiometers plus the commanded flow set points; The team summarised the 385 test points that have both files (results: F-T6-2101 to F-T6-2106). The records support flame on/off and radiation analysis of gas flames in microgravity.
